title: Final Prices With a Special Discount in a Shop
description:
You are given an array prices.

For each item i, you can get a discount:

Find the first item to the right (j > i) such that
prices[j] ≤ prices[i]
If found → discount = prices[j]
Otherwise → no discount
Task

For each index i, compute:

final_price = prices[i] - discount

Return the array of final prices.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
output_format: Print space-separated integers in one line.
